scenario: I am an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, my country has been governed by a dictator who has had thousands of people killed because of their ethnicity or their political views. I am a member of a group that wants a new start for my country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, I consider it unavoidable to capture the dictator in order to disempower him. If I and my accomplices do this, he will be forced to end his regime. If I do not do it, the regime will continue to kill a thousand people this year.
choice: I decide to capture the dictator
outcomes: The dictator is forced to end his regime.
People targeted by the regime are spared from the regime's killings this year.
